$comment: The Firefox hover specs' known failures (FIREFOX_HOVER_SPECS in .github/scripts/lib/a11y-spec-files.mjs). Each one passes in Chromium on the same build. `tracking` is a short cause label: failures that look like one cause share it, and no issue is filed under it in this repository. The Firefox report (.github/scripts/firefox-hover-report.mjs) counts these as known and every other failure as new. Remove an entry when its fix lands; the report names each known failure that now passes.
